Origin and meaning

The name Jack has English roots and means “God is gracious (diminutive of John)”.

About the name Jack

A sturdy English classic and the name of the author Jack London.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Jack carries the meaning “God is gracious (diminutive of John)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
